rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Full sequential read, chunk 0-7. Chunk1 line13 introduces "Worktrees"; chunk2 line23 "**Worktrees** are the middle path" reuses it (fine, established earlier same file). Chunk2 line29 "That creates a sibling directory" — "That" = the fenced command on line26, same chunk. Chunk3 line51 fence `../repo-bug-fix` reuses the name coined at line39 in the SAME chunk's numbered flow. Chunk4 lines56-57 "the bug-fix session"/"the feature session" reuse the worktree examples named in chunk3 lines39-41 (bug/issue-412, feature/export-csv) — term introduced on an earlier slide and reused, not a violation; fence lines61-63 reuses `../repo-feature` from chunk3 line41, same pattern. Chunk4 line68 "Agent committed to the wrong branch" is self-contained, no dangling referent. Chunk6 line86 "**New to the loop.**" / "Land the single-session loop first" — "the loop" is AE101 arc-earned spine vocabulary (orient->fix->close->compound), named repeatedly in body text of getting-going.md, learn-from-the-test.md, spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md, earn-the-trust.md well before this optional M1-M2 homework page (lede line3: "Optional homework between M1 and M2") — carve-out applies. No never-named, no vague-with-history, no re-chunk-stranded referent found anywhere in the body.

No chunk points at another file's content by position. Line3 "Optional homework between M1 and M2" states this file's own place in the sequence (scheduling), not a callback into another file's argument ("the opening lecture said..."). No other cross-file reference exists in the body.

Every chunk (0-7) carries multiple sentences or a list, each with its own self-carrying claim. Shortest is chunk7 "Close" (lines88-91, 3 sentences): milestone / habit / grown-into are three distinct claims, not a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

Re-checked the one prior finding on this file (2026-08-24/28 instances, rule6 REVISE non-blocking): chunk4's header was "Stashing and switching between sessions" while its closing beat (lines68-69, wrong-branch-commit recovery) wasn't covered by the header's noun phrase. Since that pin the header was rewritten to "Stashing, switching, and small recoveries between sessions" (current line54) — "small recoveries" now literally covers the wrong-branch-commit tip. Re-read all 8 headers against their chunk content: chunk1 "Why multi-session, why Git" matches its two-paragraph why-argument; chunk2 "Worktrees vs. branches vs. clones" matches the three-way comparison; chunk3 "Opening N Claude Code sessions on the same codebase" matches open-flow + the agent-level trap + closing a session (session lifecycle, on-topic); chunk4 now matches per above; chunk5/6/7 headers are literal restatements of their content. No header the chunk's own content contradicts.

Closest candidates: chunk3 line44 "Each session has its own scrollback, its own working directory, its own branch" and chunk2 line29 "Two folders, two branches, zero checkout churn" are anaphoric triples, but each third leg is a distinct concrete noun (branch; checkout churn), inside the exception. Chunk7 line90 "Two sessions is a milestone. Five is a habit. Ten is something you grow into." — three-part parallel with a distinct, non-formulaic third leg. No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction anywhere; no self-grading superlative; no number-with-retraction (line11's "Nothing committed is silently overwritten" is a plain declarative, not a number-then-hedge); no abstraction-noun stack; no verb-triplet with an empty leg.
